children.text: Innovation technologies are on a victorious march around the planet. They integrate into all spheres of human activity!
A restaurant called "Dijkstra's Place" has started thinking about optimizing the booking system.
booking requests received by now. Each request is characterized by two numbers:
— the size of the group of visitors who will come via this request and the total sum of money they will spend in the restaurant, correspondingly.
We know that for each request, all
people want to sit at the same table and are going to spend the whole evening in the restaurant, from the opening moment at 18:00 to the closing moment.

Your task is: given the tables and the requests, decide which requests to accept and which requests to decline so that the money paid by the happy and full visitors was maximum.
